name: Pangolin Addon (CLI)
description: Installs the official Pangolin CLI on the Proxmox host and/or one or more existing LXCs and runs Site mode (`pangolin up site`) and/or Machine Client mode (`pangolin up client`).

notes.text: Run on the Proxmox host, not inside a container. A host install exposes everything the host can reach and joins the whole host to the VPN; prefer an existing LXC.
Site mode: Site ID + secret, or a provisioning key (tier3/enterprise). Unattended needs "approve new sites" on. Reconfiguring with a key creates a second server-side site.

Components: Site tunnel (userspace WireGuard, no TUN) and Machine client (needs /dev/net/tun). Targets: Proxmox host and/or existing Debian 12+/Ubuntu 22.04+/Alpine 3.20+ LXCs, selected with var_targets or a checklist.
Client mode: create a machine client in the dashboard, then supply its ID, secret, and endpoint. Needs /dev/net/tun; the addon adds TUN passthrough to an LXC.

Unattended: `var_mode=site var_targets="host 101" var_pangolin_endpoint=URL var_site_id_101=ID var_site_secret_101=SECRET` with tools/addon/add-pangolin.sh. Mode, endpoint, native toggles, and var_reconfigure are shared; credentials are per target (suffix `host` or the CTID). One target may still use `var_target` with the unsuffixed credentials. A failed target does not stop the others; the run exits non-zero if any failed. Update: re-run the script.
